page-meta

Page attribute configuration node, which is used to specify page attributes and listen to page events.

Through this node, you can obtain the effect similar to the invoking of interfaces such as ma.setBackgroundTextStyle, ma.setBackgroundColor.

Attribute Description

Attribute Default Value Type Mandatory Description
root-font-size "" String No Root font size of the page. All rem units on the page will use this font size as a reference value, that is, 1rem is equal to this font size.

Sample Code


<page-meta root-font-size='{{rootSize}}'>
  <view id='page-meta' style='font-size:2rem'>
    page-meta
  </view>
  <view class='fontStyle'>Second node</view>
</page-meta>
